items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It’s Hemingway. It was Hemingway. That’s what Hemingway said. I said, if he can say that and do that, I’m going to do that.

ctx.x: It sounds like something Hemingway would have said.

It’s Hemingway. It was Hemingway. That’s what Hemingway said. I said, if he can say that and do that, I’m going to do that. I quit school. But not long after that I got a scholarship to Wilberforce University to play drums. I had become a drummer, because I joined the Boy Scouts, and that’s what I could play.
So you had already been playing the drums. Did you have a little drum kit?
